content:
sofia: Quick security bulletin: we're enabling stricter auth token rotation for ID tokens and introducing per-client auth rate limits for the public API. This affects SDKs, long-lived mobile sessions, and some backend clients. Please read the required actions.

kevin: What's changing and when?

sofia: Summary:
- ID token lifetime for interactive flows will be reduced from 14 days -> 24 hours (refresh tokens unchanged).
- All server-to-server ID tokens issued for service principals will default to 1h TTL.
- Public API auth rate limits by client_id will be enforced: 120 req/min by default, 600 req/min for registered high-throughput clients.
- Enforcement date: 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC. Backfill scan and ticketing starts 2026-10-20.

kevin: How do teams prepare?

sofia: Action items:
1) Update Redwood SDKs to the latest version that auto-refreshes ID tokens. If you vendor the SDK, upgrade before 2026-10-30.
2) Audit long-lived mobile/web sessions: identify clients using ID tokens >24h and ensure they use refresh tokens or silent reauth. Run: `rwdnctl auth sessions list --older-than 24h --format csv`.
3) For backend services using service principal ID tokens, switch to short-lived token fetch via OIDC or rotate to client credentials with 1h TTL. Use `rwdnctl tokens create --type service --ttl 1h --owner your-team` for transitions.
4) If you need higher API quotas, register your client_id via the quota form (link pinned in #eng-security) before 2026-10-25; approval required and tied to monitoring.

sec-bot: Scan (2026-10-18 08:00 UTC): Found 21 interactive sessions with ID tokens >48h and 7 service principals using static ID tokens >7d. Tickets: SEC-9980..SEC-9983.

idp-team: Note: We'll enable token introspection endpoint logging and will throttle clients failing refresh >5 times in 1h. If you rely on silent refresh, ensure your refresh token rotation handles 401s gracefully.

kevin: Any exemptions for embedded clients (edge appliances) that can't refresh?

sofia: Exceptions allowed but limited: submit via #eng-security exception form with compensating controls (IP allowlist, monitoring) and an explicit end date. We can grant 7-day rolling exceptions for migration.

idp-team: We'll publish sample code snippets for silent refresh and server-side refresh flows. Office hours: 2026-10-22 16:00 UTC.

kevin: Acknowledged. I'll run the session audit and open tickets for any legacy clients.

sofia: Thanks. Paste `rwdnctl` outputs in the ticket. Final reminder will post 72h and 24h before enforcement.

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-10-29 00:00 UTC.
